column1: # Stage S11 J2a — xtask's repository verifications become two check crates under tools/checks:
# repository_checks (the architecture, language-ban, licensing and registry checks, and the tooling
# tests that judge every tool crate by folder) and mod_script_checks (the Enfusion mod script
# checks; the module root becomes the crate root). The crate roots, the preludes, the errors and the
# crate READMEs are written by hand. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# repository_checks: four verification groups and the tooling tests
# mod_script_checks: the mod script verifications; their module root becomes the crate root
# xtask's consumers name the crate that now holds each check
# the moved checks name their siblings in the crate that now holds them
